items.source: beanName - the name of the bean
items.translation: beanName - 豆子的名称

items.source:
Return a provider for the specified bean, allowing for lazy on-demand retrieval
of instances, including availability and uniqueness options.
items.translation: 返回指定 Bean 的提供者，支持按需懒加载获取实例，包括可用性和唯一性选项。

items.source: requiredType - type the bean must match; can be an interface or superclass
items.translation: requiredType - 必须匹配的 Bean 类型；可以是接口或父类

items.source: annotationType - the type of annotation to look for (at class, interface or factory method level of the specified bean)
items.translation: annotationType - 要查找的注解类型（在指定 Bean 的类、接口或工厂方法级别）

items.source: a corresponding provider handle
items.translation: 相应的提供者句柄

items.source: NOTE: This method introspects top-level beans only. It does not check nested beans which might match the specified type as well.
items.translation: 注意：此方法仅检查顶层 Bean。 它不会检查可能匹配指定类型的嵌套 Bean。

items.source: Does not consider any hierarchy this factory may participate in. Use BeanFactoryUtils' beanNamesForTypeIncludingAncestors to include beans in ancestor factories too.
items.translation: 不考虑此工厂可能参与的任意层次结构。请使用 `BeanFactoryUtils` 的 `beanNamesForTypeIncludingAncestors` 方法，以包含祖先工厂中的 Bean。

items.source: Bean names returned by this method should always return bean names in the order of definition in the backend configuration, as far as possible.
items.translation: 此方法返回的 Bean 名称应始终尽可能按照后端配置中的定义顺序返回。

items.source: Find an Annotation of annotationType on the specified bean, traversing its interfaces and superclasses if no annotation can be found on the given class itself, as well as checking the bean's factory method (if any).
items.translation: 在指定的 Bean 上查找 `Annotation` 类型的 `annotationType`，如果在该类本身找不到注解，则遍历其接口和父类，同时检查 Bean 的工厂方法（如果有）。

items.source: Return the names of beans matching the given type (including subclasses), judging from either bean definitions or the value of getObjectType in the case of FactoryBeans.
items.translation: 返回与给定类型（包括子类）匹配的 Bean 名称，判断依据是 Bean 定义或 FactoryBean 的getObjectType方法的返回值。

items.source:
Determine whether the specified bean definition qualifies as an autowire candidate,
to be injected into other beans which declare a dependency of matching type.
items.translation: 确定指定的 Bean 定义是否具备自动装配候选资格，以便注入到声明了匹配类型依赖的其他 Bean 中。

items.source: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - if there is no bean with the given name
items.translation: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - 如果不存在具有给定名称的 Bean

items.source: descriptor - the descriptor of the dependency to resolve
items.translation: descriptor - 要解析的依赖项的描述符

items.source:
the names of beans (or objects created by FactoryBeans) matching
the given object type (including subclasses), or an empty array if none
items.translation: 匹配给定对象类型（包括子类）的 Bean 名称（或由 FactoryBeans 创建的对象），如果没有则返回空数组。

items.source: This method goes into ListableBeanFactory by-type lookup territory but may also be translated into a conventional by-name lookup based on the name of the given type. For more extensive retrieval operations across sets of beans, use ListableBeanFactory and/or BeanFactoryUtils.
items.translation: 此方法进入 `ListableBeanFactory` 按类型查找的范围，但也可能根据给定类型的名称转换为常规的按名称查找。对于跨越 Bean 集合的更广泛的检索操作，请使用 `ListableBeanFactory` 和/或 `BeanFactoryUtils`。

items.source: Consider ListableBeanFactory.getBeanNamesForType(Class) with selective BeanFactory.getBean(String) calls for specific bean names in preference to this Map-based retrieval method. Aside from lazy instantiation benefits, this also avoids any exception suppression.
items.translation: 考虑使用 ListableBeanFactory.getBeanNamesForType(Class) 配合针对特定 bean 名称的选择性 BeanFactory.getBean(String) 调用，而非这种基于 Map 的检索方法。 除了延迟实例化的优势外，这还可以避免任何异常抑制。

items.source:
Does consider objects created by FactoryBeans, which means that FactoryBeans
will get initialized. If the object created by the FactoryBean doesn't match,
the raw FactoryBean itself will be matched against the type.
items.translation: 是否考虑由 FactoryBean 创建的实例，这意味着 FactoryBean 将被初始化。如果由 FactoryBean 创建的实例不匹配类型，则原始 FactoryBean 本身将与该类型进行匹配。

items.source:
Does consider objects created by FactoryBeans if the "allowEagerInit" flag is set,
which means that FactoryBeans will get initialized. If the object created by the
FactoryBean doesn't match, the raw FactoryBean itself will be matched against the
type. If "allowEagerInit" is not set, only raw FactoryBeans will be checked
(which doesn't require initialization of each FactoryBean).
items.translation: 如果设置了"allowEagerInit"标志，则考虑由 FactoryBeans 创建的对象，这意味着 FactoryBeans 将被初始化。如果 FactoryBean 创建的对象不匹配，则将直接对 FactoryBean 本身进行类型匹配。如果未设置"allowEagerInit"，则仅检查原始的 FactoryBeans（这不需要初始化每个 FactoryBean）。

items.source: Public method to determine the applicable order value for a given bean.
items.translation: 用于确定给定 Bean 的适用订单值的公共方法。

items.source: allowEagerInit - whether to introspect lazy-init singletons and objects created by FactoryBeans - or by factory methods with a "factory-bean" reference - for the type check. Note that FactoryBeans need to be eagerly initialized to determine their type: So be aware that passing in "true" for this flag will initialize FactoryBeans and "factory-bean" references. Only actually necessary initialization for type checking purposes will be performed; constructor and method invocations will still be avoided as far as possible.
items.translation: allowEagerInit - 是否要检查懒加载单例和由 FactoryBeans 创建的 Bean（或由带有"factory-bean"引用的工厂方法创建的 Bean）的类型。请注意，FactoryBeans 需要被急切初始化以确定其类型：因此，请留意将此标志设置为"true"将初始化 FactoryBeans 和"factory-bean"引用。仅会执行实际必要的初始化以用于类型检查目的；仍会尽可能避免调用构造函数和方法。

items.source: BeansException - if the bean could not be created
items.translation: BeansException - 如果无法创建该 Bean

items.source: the corresponding order value (default is Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE)
items.translation: 对应的订单值（默认为Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE）

items.source: includeNonSingletons - whether to include prototype or scoped beans too or just singletons (also applies to FactoryBeans)
items.translation: includeNonSingletons - 是否包含原型或作用域 Bean，还是仅包含单例（同样适用于 FactoryBean）

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean to look for annotations on
items.translation: beanName - 要查找注解的 Bean 的名称

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean definition to check
items.translation: beanName - 要检查的 Bean 定义的名称

items.source: resolver - the AutowireCandidateResolver to use for the actual resolution algorithm
items.translation: resolver - 用于实际解析算法的 AutowireCandidateResolver。

items.source: candidates - a Map of candidate names and candidate instances (or candidate classes if not created yet) that match the required type
items.translation: candidates - 一个包含候选名称和候选实例（若尚未创建则为候选类）的 Map，这些实例匹配所需的类型

items.source: requiredType - the target dependency type to match against
items.translation: requiredType - 要匹配的目标依赖类型

items.source:
a Map with the matching beans, containing the bean names as
keys and the corresponding bean instances as values
items.translation: 一个包含匹配 Bean 的 Map，其中键为 Bean 名称，值为相应的 Bean 实例。

items.source: whether the bean should be considered as autowire candidate
items.translation: bean 是否应被视为自动注入候选者

items.source: The default implementation delegates to the specified dependency comparator, checking its method if it is an extension of Spring's common OrderComparator - typically, an AnnotationAwareOrderComparator. If no such comparator is present, this implementation returns null.
items.translation: 默认实现会委托给指定的依赖比较器，检查其方法是否为 Spring 通用 OrderComparator 的扩展——通常是 AnnotationAwareOrderComparator。如果没有这样的比较器，此实现将返回 null。

items.source: Called after an existing bean definition has been replaced or removed, triggering clearMergedBeanDefinition(String), destroySingleton(String) and MergedBeanDefinitionPostProcessor.resetBeanDefinition(String) on the given bean and on all bean definitions that have the given bean as parent.
items.translation: 在现有的 Bean 定义被替换或删除后调用，触发给定 Bean 及其所有以该 Bean 为父 Bean 的 Bean 定义上的 clearMergedBeanDefinition(String)、destroySingleton(String) 和 MergedBeanDefinitionPostProcessor.resetBeanDefinition(String)。

items.source: By default, all threads are forced to hold a full lock through null. DefaultListableBeanFactory overrides this to specifically handle its threads during the pre-instantiation phase: true for the main thread, false for managed background threads, and configuration-dependent behavior for unmanaged threads.
items.translation: 默认情况下，所有线程都通过 `null` 被强制持有完整锁。`DefaultListableBeanFactory` 对此进行了覆盖，以专门处理其预实例化阶段的线程：主线程为 `true`，托管后台线程为 `false`，未托管线程的行为则取决于配置。

items.source: For an alternative implementation of the ListableBeanFactory interface, have a look at StaticListableBeanFactory, which manages existing bean instances rather than creating new ones based on bean definitions.
items.translation: 对于`ListableBeanFactory`接口的替代实现，请查看StaticListableBeanFactory，它管理现有的bean实例，而不是基于bean定义创建新的实例。

items.source: Also, generics matching is strict here, as per the Java assignment rules. For lenient fallback matching with unchecked semantics (similar to the 'unchecked' Java compiler warning), consider calling BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(Class) with the raw type as a second step if no full generic match is available with this variant.
items.translation: 此外，这里的泛型匹配是严格的，遵循 Java 赋值规则。如果未找到完整的泛型匹配且此变体不可用（available），则考虑将原始类型作为第二步传递给 BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(Class)，以实现宽松的回退匹配（具有 unchecked 语义，类似于 Java 编译器的 'unchecked' 警告）。

items.source: This is a variant of BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(ResolvableType) with a captured generic type for type-safe retrieval, typically used inline: getBeanProvider(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {}) - and effectively equivalent to getBeanProvider(ResolvableType.forType(...)).
items.translation: 这是 `BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(ResolvableType)` 的一个变体，具有捕获的泛型类型以实现类型安全的检索，通常用于内联：`getBeanProvider(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {})` - 并且实际上等同于 `getBeanProvider(ResolvableType.forType(...))`。

items.source: NOTE: This method introspects top-level beans only. It does not check nested beans which might match the specified type as well. Also, it suppresses exceptions for beans that are currently in creation in a circular reference scenario: typically, references back to the caller of this method.
items.translation: 注意：此方法仅检查顶层 Bean。 它不会检查可能匹配指定类型的嵌套 Bean。此外，在循环引用场景中，它会**抑制正在创建中的 Bean 的异常：**通常是指向此方法调用者的引用。

items.source: Based on @jakarta.annotation.Priority. As defined by the related Ordered interface, the lowest value has the highest priority.
items.translation: 基于@jakarta.annotation.Priority。根据相关Ordered接口的定义，最低值具有最高优先级。

items.source: Note that readers for specific bean definition formats are typically implemented separately rather than as bean factory subclasses: see for example XmlBeanDefinitionReader.
items.translation: 请注意，针对特定 Bean 定义格式的读取器通常是单独实现的，而不是作为 BeanFactory 的子类；例如，请参阅 XmlBeanDefinitionReader。

items.source: For matching a generic type, consider BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(ResolvableType).
items.translation: 对于匹配泛型类型，请考虑BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(ResolvableType)。

items.source: Note that collections of beans are not supported here, in contrast to reflective injection points. For programmatically retrieving a list of beans matching a specific type, specify the actual bean type as an argument here and subsequently use ObjectProvider.orderedStream() or its lazy streaming/iteration options.
items.translation: 请注意，此处不支持集合形式的 Bean，这与反射注入点不同。若要程序化地检索与特定类型匹配的 Bean 列表，请在此处指定实际的 Bean 类型作为参数，随后使用ObjectProvider.orderedStream()或其懒式流/迭代选项。

items.source: This version of getBeanNamesForType matches all kinds of beans, be it singletons, prototypes, or FactoryBeans. In most implementations, the result will be the same as for getBeanNamesForType(type, true, true).
items.translation: 此版本的 `getBeanNamesForType` 匹配所有类型的 Bean，无论是单例、原型还是 FactoryBeans。在大多数实现中，结果与 `getBeanNamesForType(type, true, true)` 相同。

items.source: Any such marker is to be removed at the end of the managed bootstrap in ConfigurableListableBeanFactory.preInstantiateSingletons().
items.translation: 任何此类标记都应在受管理的引导结束时，在`ConfigurableListableBeanFactory.preInstantiateSingletons()`中移除。

items.source: Looks for @Primary and @Priority (in that order).
items.translation: 查找@Primary和@Priority（按此顺序）。

items.source: Does not consider any hierarchy this factory may participate in. Use BeanFactoryUtils' beansOfTypeIncludingAncestors to include beans in ancestor factories too.
items.translation: 不考虑该工厂可能参与的任何层次结构。请使用 `BeanFactoryUtils` 的 `beansOfTypeIncludingAncestors` 方法，以包含祖先工厂中的 Bean。

items.source: The Map returned by this method should always return bean names and corresponding bean instances in the order of definition in the backend configuration, as far as possible.
items.translation: 此方法返回的 Map 应始终尽可能按照后端配置中定义顺序返回 Bean 名称及对应的 Bean 实例。

items.source:
Typical usage is registering all bean definitions first (possibly read
from a bean definition file), before accessing beans. Bean lookup by name
is therefore an inexpensive operation in a local bean definition table,
operating on pre-resolved bean definition metadata objects.
items.translation: 典型用法是先注册所有 bean 定义（可能从 bean 定义文件中读取），然后再访问 bean。因此，在本地 bean 定义表中按名称查找 bean 是一个廉价的操作，它操作的是预先解析的 bean 定义元数据对象。

items.source:
By default, the factory infers strict locking from the encountered thread names:
If additional threads have names that match the thread prefix of the main bootstrap thread,
they are considered external (multiple external bootstrap threads calling into the factory)
and therefore have strict locking applied to them. This inference can be turned off through
explicitly setting this flag to "false" rather than leaving it unspecified.
items.translation: 默认情况下，工厂根据遇到的线程名称推断严格锁定：如果存在其他线程的名称与主引导线程的线程前缀匹配，则这些线程被视为外部（多个外部引导线程调用工厂），因此对其应用严格锁定。可以通过将此标志显式设置为"false"来关闭此推断，而不是将其留为未指定。

items.source:
Default is "true". Turn this flag off to suppress class loading
for lazy-init beans unless such a bean is explicitly requested.
In particular, by-type lookups will then simply ignore bean definitions
without resolved class name, instead of loading the bean classes on
demand just to perform a type check.
items.translation: 默认值为 "true"。关闭此标志可抑制懒初始化 Bean 的类加载，除非显式请求此类 Bean。特别是，按类型查找将忽略未解析类名的 Bean 定义，而不会按需加载 Bean 类以执行类型检查。

items.source:
Depending on the nature of the concrete bean factory implementation,
this operation might be expensive (for example, because of directory lookups
in external registries). However, for listable bean factories, this usually
just amounts to a local hash lookup: The operation is therefore part of the
public interface there. The same implementation can serve for both this
template method and the public interface method in that case.
items.translation: 具体取决于 BeanFactory 实现的类型，此操作可能代价高昂（例如，由于在外部注册表中执行目录查找）。然而，对于可列举的 BeanFactory，这通常仅涉及本地哈希查找：因此，该操作是该公共接口的一部分。在这种情况下，相同的实现可同时用于此模板方法和公共接口方法。

items.source:
Does not consider any hierarchy this factory may participate in,
and ignores any singleton beans that have been registered by
other means than bean definitions.
items.translation: 该工厂不考虑其可能参与的任意层次结构，并且会忽略通过除 Bean 定义以外的其他方式注册的任意单例 Bean。

items.source:
Note that this method considers objects created by FactoryBeans, which means
that FactoryBeans will get initialized in order to determine their object type.
items.translation: 注意，此方法会考虑由 FactoryBean 创建的对象，这意味着 FactoryBean 将被初始化以确定其对象类型。

items.source: To be called for exposure of freshly registered/created singletons.
items.translation: 用于调用新注册或创建的单例对象的暴露。

items.source: This variant implicitly obtains a corresponding bean instance from this factory.
items.translation: 该变体隐式地从此工厂获取相应的 Bean 实例。

items.source: Return the Executor (possibly a TaskExecutor) for background bootstrapping, if any.
items.translation: 返回用于后台引导的Executor（可能是TaskExecutor），如果有。

items.source: Set the Executor (possibly a TaskExecutor) for background bootstrapping.
items.translation: 设置用于后台引导的Executor（可能是TaskExecutor）。

items.source: Find all Annotation instances of annotationType on the specified bean, traversing its interfaces and superclasses if no annotation can be found on the given class itself, as well as checking the bean's factory method (if any).
items.translation: 在指定的 `annotationType`` 的 Annotation 实例，遍历其接口和父类（如果在给定类本身找不到注解），以及检查 bean 的工厂方法（如果有）。

items.source: Set a Comparator for dependency Lists and arrays.
items.translation: 为依赖列表和数组设置一个 `Comparator`。

items.source: Return the autowire candidate resolver for this BeanFactory (never null).
items.translation: 返回此 BeanFactory 的自动注入候选解析器（永远不为 `null`）。

items.source: Return the bean instances that match the given object type (including subclasses), judging from either bean definitions or the value of getObjectType in the case of FactoryBeans.
items.translation: 返回与给定对象类型（包括子类）匹配的 Bean 实例，判断依据是 Bean 定义或 FactoryBean 的 `getObjectType` 方法返回值。

items.source: Return the dependency comparator for this BeanFactory (may be null).
items.translation: 返回此 BeanFactory 的依赖比较器（可能为null）。

items.source: This implementation returns true if bean definition overriding is generally allowed.
items.translation: 此实现如果通常允许覆盖 Bean 定义，则返回true。

items.source: Destroy the given bean. Delegates to destroyBean if a corresponding disposable bean instance is found.
items.translation: 销毁给定的 Bean。如果找到对应的可丢弃 Bean 实例，则委托给destroyBean。

items.source: Create a new DefaultListableBeanFactory.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 DefaultListableBeanFactory。

to be deserialized from this id back into the BeanFactory object, if needed.

items.source:
Return whether it should be allowed to override bean definitions by registering
a different definition with the same name, automatically replacing the former.
items.translation: 返回是否允许通过注册具有相同名称的不同定义来覆盖 Bean 定义，并自动替换前者。

items.source:
Return whether the factory is allowed to eagerly load bean classes
even for bean definitions that are marked as "lazy-init".

items.source:

items.source:

marked as a primary bean.
items.translation: 返回给定 Bean 名称的 Bean 定义是否已被标记为 Primary Bean。

items.source:
Determine whether the given dependency name matches the bean name or the aliases

items.translation: 确定给定的依赖名称是否与此 Bean 定义中存储的 Bean 名称或别名匹配。

items.source: Resolve the specified dependency against the beans defined in this factory.

items.source:
Set a custom autowire candidate resolver for this BeanFactory to use
when deciding whether a bean definition should be considered as a
candidate for autowiring.
items.translation: 为此 BeanFactory 设置自定义的自动装配候选解析器，用于决定是否应将某个 Bean 定义视为自动装配的候选项。

items.source:
Specify an id for serialization purposes, allowing this BeanFactory to be
deserialized from this id back into the BeanFactory object, if needed.
items.translation: 指定一个用于序列化的 id，以便在需要时能够从该 id 反序列化回 BeanFactory 对象。

items.source:
Find bean instances that match the required type.
Called during autowiring for the specified bean.
items.translation: 查找与所需类型匹配的 Bean 实例。在指定 Bean 的自动装配期间调用。

items.source: allowEagerInit - whether stream access may introspect lazy-init singletons and objects created by FactoryBeans - or by factory methods with a "factory-bean" reference - for the type check. Note that FactoryBeans need to be eagerly initialized to determine their type: So be aware that passing in "true" for this flag will initialize FactoryBeans and "factory-bean" references. Only actually necessary initialization for type checking purposes will be performed; constructor and method invocations will still be avoided as far as possible.
items.translation: allowEagerInit - 是否允许流访问在类型检查时内省懒加载单例和由 FactoryBeans 创建的 Bean（或由带有"factory-bean"引用的工厂方法创建的对象）。请注意，FactoryBeans 需要被急切初始化以确定其类型：因此，请留意将此标志设置为"true"将导致 FactoryBeans 和"factory-bean"引用被初始化。仅会执行类型检查所需的确切初始化；将尽可能避免调用构造函数和方法。

items.source: requiredType - type the bean must match; can be a generic type declaration. Note that collection types are not supported here, in contrast to reflective injection points. For programmatically retrieving a list of beans matching a specific type, specify the actual bean type as an argument here and subsequently use ObjectProvider.orderedStream() or its lazy streaming/iteration options.
items.translation: requiredType - 必须匹配的 Bean 类型；可以是泛型类型声明。 请注意，此处不支持集合类型，这与反射注入点不同。若要程序化地检索匹配特定类型的 Bean 列表，请将实际的 Bean 类型作为参数指定于此，随后使用 ObjectProvider.orderedStream() 或其惰性流/迭代选项。

items.source: true if the current thread is explicitly allowed to hold the lock but also accepts lenient fallback behavior, false if it is explicitly not allowed to hold the lock and therefore forced to use lenient fallback behavior, or null if there is no specific indication (traditional behavior: forced to always hold a full lock)
items.translation: 如果当前线程被明确允许持有锁但也接受宽松的回退行为，则为true；如果被明确禁止持有锁并因此被迫使用宽松的回退行为，则为false；如果没有具体指示（传统行为：始终被迫持有完整锁），则为null。

items.source: candidates - a Map of candidate names and candidate instances that match the required type, as returned by findAutowireCandidates(String, Class, DependencyDescriptor)
items.translation: `candidates` - 一个包含候选名称和匹配所需类型的候选实例的 Map，由 findAutowireCandidates(String, Class, DependencyDescriptor) 返回

items.source: type - the class or interface to match, or null for all bean names
items.translation: type - 要匹配的类或接口，或者为所有 Bean 名称指定为 null。

items.source: type - the class or interface to match, or null for all concrete beans
items.translation: type - 要匹配的类或接口，或者为所有具体 Bean 指定为 null

items.source: BeansException - if a bean could not be created
items.translation: BeansException - 如果无法创建 Bean

items.source: allowFactoryBeanInit - whether a FactoryBean may get initialized just for the purpose of determining its object type
items.translation: allowFactoryBeanInit - 是否允许仅为了确定其对象类型而初始化 FactoryBean

items.source: NoUniqueBeanDefinitionException - if multiple beans are detected with the same highest priority value
items.translation: `NoUniqueBeanDefinitionException` - 如果检测到多个具有相同最高优先级值的 Bean。

items.source: beanInstance - the corresponding bean instance (can be null)
items.translation: beanInstance - 对应的 Bean 实例（可为 null）

items.source: beanInstance - the bean instance to check (can be null)
items.translation: beanInstance - 要检查的 Bean 实例（可以为 null）

items.source: type - the generically typed class or interface to match
items.translation: type - 要匹配的泛型类型类或接口

items.source: the annotation of the given type if found, or null otherwise
items.translation: 如果找到给定类型的注解，则返回该注解；否则返回null。

items.source: mbd - the merged bean definition to check
items.translation: mbd - 要检查的合并 Bean 定义

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean instance to register
items.translation: beanName - 要注册的 Bean 实例的名称

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean to reset
items.translation: beanName - 要重置的 Bean 的名称

items.source: name - the candidate name
items.translation: name - 候选人姓名

items.source: alias - the candidate alias
items.translation: alias - 候选别名

items.source: singletonObject - the singleton object
items.translation: singletonObject - 单例对象

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean that is about to be wired
items.translation: beanName - 即将进行注入的 Bean 的名称

items.source: requiredType - the actual type of bean to look for (may be an array component type or collection element type)
items.translation: requiredType - 要查找的 Bean 的实际类型（可能是数组组件类型或集合元素类型）

items.source: a Map of candidate names and candidate instances that match the required type (never null)
items.translation: 一个包含候选名称和匹配所需类型的候选实例的 Map（永远不为null）

items.source: descriptor - the target dependency to match against
items.translation: descriptor - 用于匹配的目标依赖项

items.source: the name of the autowire candidate, or null if none found
items.translation: 自注入候选者的名称，或者如果未找到则为null

items.source: the name of the primary candidate, or null if none found
items.translation: 主候选人的名称，或者如果未找到则为null

items.source: the name of the candidate with the highest priority, or null if none found
items.translation: 优先级最高的候选人姓名，若未找到则返回null。

items.source: the priority assigned to that bean or null if none is set
items.translation: 分配给该 Bean 的优先级，或者如果未设置则为null。

items.translation: beanInstance - 要检查的 Bean 实例

items.source: whether the given bean qualifies as primary
items.translation: 给定的 Bean 是否作为主 Bean 资格

items.source: The given instance is supposed to be fully initialized; the registry will not perform any initialization callbacks (in particular, it won't call InitializingBean's afterPropertiesSet method). The given instance will not receive any destruction callbacks (like DisposableBean's destroy method) either.
items.translation: 给定的实例应已完全初始化；注册表将不会执行任何初始化回调（特别是，它不会调用 InitializingBean 的afterPropertiesSet方法）。给定的实例也不会接收任何销毁回调（例如 DisposableBean 的destroy方法）。

items.source: This is effectively a variant of BeanFactory.getBean(Class) which preserves the bean name of the matching instance.
items.translation: 这实际上是 `BeanFactory.getBean(Class)` 的一个变体，它会保留匹配实例的 bean 名称。

items.source: This version of getBeansOfType matches all kinds of beans, be it singletons, prototypes, or FactoryBeans. In most implementations, the result will be the same as for getBeansOfType(type, true, true).
items.translation: 此版本的 `getBeansOfType` 匹配所有类型的 Bean，无论是单例、原型还是 `FactoryBean`。在大多数实现中，结果与 `getBeansOfType(type, true, true)` 相同。

items.source: Typically triggered after changes to the original bean definitions, for example, after applying a BeanFactoryPostProcessor. Note that metadata for beans which have already been created at this point will be kept around.
items.translation: 通常在原始 Bean 定义发生变化后触发，例如在应用了 `BeanFactoryPostProcessor` 之后。请注意，此时已经创建的 Bean 的元数据将被保留。

items.source: When running within a full BeanFactory: Register a bean definition instead of an existing instance if your bean is supposed to receive initialization and/or destruction callbacks.
items.translation: 在完整的 BeanFactory 中运行时：如果您的 Bean 需要接收初始化和/或销毁回调，请注册 Bean 定义而不是现有实例。

items.source: Default is "true".
items.translation: 默认值为"true"。

items.source:
Should include all standard configuration settings as well as
BeanPostProcessors, Scopes, and factory-specific internal settings.
Should not include any metadata of actual bean definitions,
such as BeanDefinition objects and bean name aliases.
items.translation: 应包含所有标准配置设置，以及 BeanPostProcessor、作用域和工厂特定的内部设置。不应包含实际 bean 定义的元数据，例如 BeanDefinition 对象和 bean 名称别名。

items.source:
Allows for specifying explicit constructor arguments / factory method arguments,
overriding the specified default arguments (if any) in the bean definition.
Note that the provided arguments need to match a specific candidate constructor /
factory method in the order of declared parameters.
items.translation: 允许指定显式的构造函数参数/工厂方法参数，覆盖 Bean 定义中指定的默认参数（如果有）。请注意，提供的参数必须按照声明参数的顺序与特定的候选构造函数/工厂方法相匹配。

items.source:
This is intended for factory/context references that are supposed
to be autowirable but are not defined as beans in the factory:
for example, a dependency of type ApplicationContext resolved to the
ApplicationContext instance that the bean is living in.
items.translation: 这旨在用于工厂/上下文引用，这些引用本应支持自动注入，但在工厂中未定义为 Bean：例如，类型为 `ApplicationContext` 的依赖项被解析为该 Bean 所在的 `ApplicationContext` 实例。

items.source:
Note: There are no such default types registered in a plain BeanFactory,
not even for the BeanFactory interface itself.
items.translation: 注意：在普通的 BeanFactory 中，没有注册任何此类默认类型，甚至不包括 BeanFactory 接口本身。

items.source: This method checks ancestor factories as well.
items.translation: 此方法也会检查祖先工厂。

items.source:
Includes bean definition names as well as names of manually registered
singleton instances, with bean definition names consistently coming first,
analogous to how type/annotation specific retrieval of bean names works.
items.translation: 包含 Bean 定义名称以及手动注册的单例实例名称，其中 Bean 定义名称始终排在前面，类似于按类型/注解获取 Bean 名称的方式。

items.source:
This allows the factory to aggressively cache bean definition metadata
going forward, after clearing the initial temporary metadata cache.
items.translation: 这允许工厂在清除初始临时元数据缓存后，从此积极缓存 Bean 定义元数据。

items.source:
Subclasses can override this to derive additional cached state
from the final post-processed bean definition.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法，从最终的已后处理的 Bean 定义中派生额外的缓存状态。

items.source:
Typically invoked during registry configuration, but can also be used
for runtime registration of singletons. As a consequence, a registry
implementation should synchronize singleton access; it will have to do
this anyway if it supports a BeanFactory's lazy initialization of singletons.
items.translation: 通常在注册表配置期间调用，但也可用于单例的运行时注册。因此，注册表实现应同步对单例的访问；如果它支持 BeanFactory 的单例延迟初始化，无论如何都必须执行此操作。

items.source:
Any exception that arises during destruction should be caught
and logged instead of propagated to the caller of this method.
items.translation: 任何在销毁过程中引发的异常都应被捕获并记录，而不是传播到此方法的调用者。

items.source: Description copied from interface: ConfigurableBeanFactory
items.translation: 描述从接口复制：ConfigurableBeanFactory

items.source: Find all names of beans which are annotated with the supplied Annotation type, without creating corresponding bean instances yet.
items.translation: 查找所有带有提供的 Annotation 类型注解的 Bean 名称，而无需创建相应的 Bean 实例。

items.source: Find all beans which are annotated with the supplied Annotation type, returning a Map of bean names with corresponding bean instances.
items.translation: 查找所有带有提供的 Annotation 类型注解的 Bean，并返回一个包含 Bean 名称和相应 Bean 实例的 Map。

items.source: Ensure that all non-lazy-init singletons are instantiated, also considering FactoryBeans.
items.translation: 确保所有非懒加载单例都得到实例化，同时考虑 FactoryBeans。

items.source: Ensure that all non-lazy-init singletons are instantiated, also considering FactoryBeans. Typically invoked at the end of factory setup, if desired.
items.translation: 确保所有非懒加载单例实例化，同时考虑 FactoryBeans。 通常在工厂设置结束时调用，如果希望如此。

items.source: Return the priority assigned for the given bean instance by the jakarta.annotation.Priority annotation.
items.translation: 返回由 `jakarta.annotation.Priority` 注解为给定 Bean 实例分配的优先级。

items.source:
System property that instructs Spring to enforce strict locking during bean creation,
rather than the mix of strict and lenient locking that 6.2 applies by default.
items.translation: 用于指示 Spring 在创建 Bean 时强制执行严格锁定，而不是默认采用的 6.2 版本中混合的严格和宽松锁定的系统属性。
